title: Psutils: pypdf has possible large memory usage when parsing cross-reference streams (CVE-2026-119209)
description: CVE-2026-119209 is a vulnerability in pypdf used by psutils that allows an attacker to craft a PDF file with cross-reference streams causing large memory usage when parsed. This can lead to resource exhaustion on the system processing the malicious PDF. The issue has been fixed in pypdf version 6.21.3.
